projects.title: My Projects
projects.description: Some of my highlighted work that showcases web, mobile, and full-stack solutions.

items.title: MindfulDesk (Chrome Extension)
items.description: A React + TypeScript Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) for productivity and wellness. Features include focus timer, hydration & mood tracking, breathing exercises, and posture reminders. Built with scalable components and TailwindCSS.

items.title: ClippyGo
items.description: A React + TypeScript app to manage and reuse job application details. Includes copy-to-clipboard for all fields, inline editing, field renaming, delete support, drag-and-drop reordering, and JSON import/export.

items.title: Sathyabama Dental: Digitalization
items.description: Full-stack hospital management system for dental departments using ReactJS, Nest.js, PostgreSQL, and TypeScript. Designed architecture, built UI forms, engineered Node.js APIs, implemented staff/admin roles, and deployed with Heroku CI/CD.

items.title: eCommerce Application
items.description: A full-stack Angular + Firebase eCommerce app with RazorPay integration. Features product management, orders, payments, and admin dashboard for CRUD operations. Uses Firestore DB, Firebase Cloud Functions, and Angular Material UI.
